title: Vampire Vape Purple Craze 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape’s Purple Craze Nic Salt merges the best of two iconic e-liquids: Heisenberg and Pinkman. This flavour offers a vibrant blend of ripe red berries and mixed fruits, with just a hint of Heisenberg’s cool menthol breeze to balance the sweet and tangy notes of Pinkman’s ruby-red berry base. Purple Craze is the perfect option for vapers who enjoy complex fruit flavours with a light menthol twist. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Purple Craze Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices and pod kits. Nicotine salts provide a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption compared to traditional freebase nicotine, making these e-liquids perfect for vapers seeking rapid nicotine relief in 10mg or 20mg strengths.
